Usage guidance

Purpose

Use a Badge to tag an item inline with a short, non-interactive status word — e.g. “Recommended” beside a connectable source. It supplements the label; it never replaces it.

Content

One or two words only (Recommended, New, Beta). Never place long-form text, counts, or interactive controls inside a Badge.

Placement

Sits immediately after the item name on the same line, vertically centered. Keep to one Badge per item.

Accessibility

The Badge is decorative reinforcement — the same meaning must be conveyed elsewhere (e.g. a Recommended filter). It has no states, focus, or role.
